_comment: Plain-text templates for dashboard/batch_ask.py. {placeholders} are filled from the structured record; nothing here may carry a dollar amount, route score, request id or urgency label. Edit and rebuild (`python3 build.py dashboard`).

roster.opening: here is what routes to you this cycle, reply with what you can take.
roster.closing: Anything you can't take, say so and it goes back into the pool for next cycle.

offerer.opening: you offered on {offers}; these asks are still open.
offerer.closing: If the door is still open, reply with which of these you can make happen and we will send the details.

path.offer: per your offer in the thread on {date}
path.offer_undated: per your offer in the thread

block.title: - {title} ({requesters}){repeat}
block.retry: retry: {connector} introduced {requester} there on {date} and it went quiet, so a fresh name would help
block.retry_own: retry: you introduced {requester} there on {date} and it went quiet, so a fresh name (or a nudge to the first) would help
